summary: Risk-on relief rally as US-Iran ceasefire held and WTI fell below $70 for the first time since 27 Feb. A semiconductor squeeze (SOXX +4.14%, ALAB +16%, KLAC +12%) led, while Alphabet's Dow debut drove DJI to a record close above 52,000. Breadth was narrow (SPX 228/271 Adv/Dec, RUT flat) — a bounce, not a confirmed trend turn.
